name: io.github.nickoscope/nickol-knx-mcp
title: nickol-knx
description: Design-time KNX/ETS assistant: read-only .knxproj analysis (naming, DPT, command/status pairing, KNX Secure, topology), device decomposition, and generation of Home Assistant YAML, ETS exports and an as-built handover pack. No live-bus access.

environmentVariables.name: NICKOL_KNX_WORKSPACE
environmentVariables.description: Directory the server may write generated files into (reports, HA YAML, ETS exports). Defaults to ./knx-workspace

environmentVariables.name: NICKOL_KNX_CATALOG
environmentVariables.description: Optional path to a local device catalog for exact vendor decomposition
